study_identification_part.si4_title: Contrasting Case-Control and Normative Reference Approaches to Capture Clinically Relevant Structural Brain Abnormalities in Patients With First-Episode Psychosis Who Are Antipsychotic Naive

cm1_research_objectives.reason: Objectives are explicitly stated and the purpose of applying normative modeling is clear: to test whether baseline deviations from a normative reference range in subcortical volumes better predict antipsychotic treatment response than raw volumes.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: OBJECTIVE To evaluate whether baseline deviations from a normative reference range in subcortical volumes are better predictors of antipsychotic treatment response than raw volumes...

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: An EXISTING normative model was used and cited in-text. Local healthy controls (n=92) were used for calibration with clear eligibility criteria (e.g., exclusion of controls with personal mental illness or family history of psychosis). However, explicit imaging quality/completeness standards for controls and detailed exclusion reasons for the local reference sample are not described.
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: We quantified individual deviations... based on a normative reference model (n = 58 836) using the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience and brain charts toolkits... We used control data to calibrate normative curves. Controls with a personal history of a mental illness or family history of psychosis in a first-degree relative were excluded.

nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.reason: Age and sex are addressed (controls matched by age and sex). Site effects are handled via calibration using local healthy controls to learn site effects, as described in the model adaptation figure text.
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.supporting_text: Controls were matched by age and sex. ... To transfer the normative models to new sites, healthy controls from the new data set are used to learn site effects.

nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.reason: The study specifies that deviations are computed from a large existing normative reference (n=58,836) using the PCN and brain charts toolkits, implying citation to the original publications. nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.supporting_text: ...based on a normative reference model (n = 58 836) using the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience and brain charts toolkits (Figure 1).

cr1_selection_criteria_clinical_cohort.reason: Eligibility and diagnostic criteria are described (antipsychotic-naive FEP, exclusions for medical conditions/substance use, MRI contraindications; consensus diagnoses by 2 psychiatrists). Sample sizes and recruitment flow are reported. However, explicit MRI image quality/completeness standards are not described.
cr1_selection_criteria_clinical_cohort.supporting_text: Participants were excluded if they had significant medical conditions, substance use disorders (except nicotine or cannabis use), or MRI contraindications. Patients were naive to antipsychotic medications... Controls with a personal history of a mental illness or family history of psychosis... were excluded. A total of 286 patients were screened, 114 consented, 104 enrolled, and 85 completed.

cr2_handling_of_clinical_covariates.reason: Analyses include age and sex as covariates for raw volume correlations, and deviations are correlated with treatment response without additional clinical covariates (e.g., medication status, illness duration, symptom severity beyond the outcome), so clinical covariates beyond demographics are not incorporated.
cr2_handling_of_clinical_covariates.supporting_text: We performed partial correlations between raw volumes and treatment response (age and sex as covariates), and Pearson correlations between deviations and treatment response.

cr3_data_sources_clinical_cohort.supporting_text: ... patients with first-episode psychosis who were referred from different clinical settings ... at the University of Alabama at Birmingham ... Data were collected between June 2016 and July 2021...

cr5_clinical_assessment_measures.supporting_text: Consensus diagnoses were established by 2 psychiatrists (A.C.L. and N.V.K.). Symptom severity was assessed using the Brief Psychiatric Rating Scale; treatment response was calculated as percentage improvement of positive symptoms...

cr6_interpretation_of_deviation_scores.supporting_text: ...positive (higher volumes compared with the normative range) and negative (lower volumes compared with the normative range) deviations... We also computed extreme deviations (2 or more SDs). ... negative deviations in key dopaminergic brain regions were most predictive of favorable treatment response.
